sentences.text: Respondent - State of Madhya Pradesh by Shri H.S. Rathor Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the Advocate General.
Complainant - objector by Shri Ashutosh Surana - Advocate.

Per: Justice Binod Kumar Dwivedi Heard on IA No.6006 of 2025 , a repeat (sixth) application under Section 430 (1) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 389 (1) of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973) filed on behalf of appellant - Rehan @ Sharukh S/o Abdul Rehman Khan for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence.

Vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 05.10.2021 passed by learned Third Additional Judge to the Court of First Additional Sessions Judge, Rajgarh District Rajgarh-Biaora (MP) in Session Trial No.128 of 2019, the present appellant stands convicted under Sections 376 (2)
(N), 450, 363 read with Section 34 and 366 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (herein after referred to as the IPC) and respectively sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for ten years with fine of Rs.10,000/-, two years with fine of Rs.2,000/-, three years with fine of Rs.3,000/- and five years with fine of Rs.5,000/- along with default stipulations.

entities.text: First Additional Sessions Judge, Rajgarh District Rajgarh-Biaora
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant was granted benefit of suspension of sentence vide order dated 17.05.2024, but the same was recalled vide order dated 13.09.2024 while allowing IA No.10707 of 2024 filed on behalf of the respondent - State on the ground that after being released on bail, the appellant again indulged in an offence, threatening the prosecutrix through instagram; and First Information Report (FIR) regarding the same was lodged on 28.05.2024.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has not misused the liberty of bail and suspension of jail sentence and the so called instagram messages and chatting are not initiated by Rehan @ Sharukh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162464244/
1 the appellant.

sentences.text: The veracity of these allegations and messages have not been verified.

The appellant has already suffered more than half of the jail sentence (he is in jail since 25.01.2019) and after cancellation of his bail by this Court vide order dated 13.09.2024, he is suffering jail incarceration.
Final hearing of this appeal may take time.
The appellant has fair chances of success in this appeal.
In the subsequent offence, the appellant has been examined before the trial Court.
There are no chances of interfering with the evidence in subsequent offence.
Under such circumstances, learned counsel prays for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.

Learned counsel for the complainant - objector has opposed the prayer on the ground that benefit of bail and suspension of jail sentence granted to the appellant was revoked on the basis of his involvement in another offence by threatening and making attempts to contact the prosecutrix through messages; and therefore, prays for rejection of the suspension application.

Learned counsel appearing for the respondent - State has also opposed the prayer on the grounds similar to those taken by the complainant - objector, therefore, prays for dismissal of the application.

Heard and considered rival submissions raised at Bar and also perused the record as well as case diary of subsequent offence committed by the present appellant i.e. Crime No.162 of 2024 registered at Police Station Tilak Nagar, District Indore (MP) for offence under Sections 354 (D) of IPC, under Section 3 read with Section 5 of Madhya Pradesh Dharmik Swatantra Adhiniyam, 2021 as well as under Section 67 of the Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008.
It is not in dispute that after scrutinizing the evidence on record vide order dated 17.05.2024 the appellant was granted suspension of his jail sentence, but it was recalled vide order dated 13.09.2024, as mentioned herein above.
From perusal of case diary of Crime No.162 of 2024 and the material available in entirety, where the veracity of the messages allegedly forwarded from fake instagram ID created by the appellant is under dispute.

entities.text: Police Station Tilak Nagar, District Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Thus, this Court is of the considered view that a case for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant is made out.

Accordingly, without commenting anything on merit of the matter, IA No.6006 of 2025 is allowed and it is directed that subject to depositing fine amount (if not already deposited) and on furnishing personal bond by the appellant in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with two solvent sureties in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) 4 CRA-6509-2021 each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court, the execution of custodial part of the jail sentence of the present appellant shall remain suspended, till the final disposal of this appeal.

The present appellant, after being enlarged on bail, shall mark his presence before the Registry of this Court on 08.12.2025 and on all such subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard.

It is further directed that the appellant will not in any manner what-so- ever contact the victim /
prosecutrix; and if any, complaint is raised in this behalf, his order of suspension will be further Rehan @ Sharukh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 October, 2025
